description: I was raised to believe that when people gathered for a meal, no one started eating until everybody had a seat.Maybe that sounds simple, but to me, it was one of the first lessons in community: notice who’s missing, make room for them, and don’t rush ahead pretending the table is full when somebody still needs a seat.That’s the spirit I’m bringing into this moment in Pennsylvania’s 199th District.I know this community includes people who have been showing up for years, people who just registered

title: We Can’t Do This Without You
